column1: # Project X scripting API migration map (client plugin API 2.7.0).
# Columns: kind, old, new, old_import, new_import, rule. Tab-separated, one rule per row.
# kinds: class = static helper (new class extends the old one); model / query-type = type rename;
#   enum-constants = constant holder (enum type keeps its name); expr = expression rewrite;
#   method-optional = optional same-behaviour rename; import = import fix-ups; keep = not aliased, why.
# Old names keep working forever (deprecated only); a file can be migrated partly.
